## BLUF — final state

Both features shipped, then hardened through five on-box test rounds. Final verified matrix
(build `8f47655`, user-tested 2026-08-14):

| App | `<leader>d` / `<leader>t` | `<leader>v` ShiftClick | `<leader>v` Drag |
|---|---|---|---|
| Edge | works | works | works |
| Notepad3 | works | works | works |
| Feishu | alternates work/fail | no selection | selection made, then canceled |

**Decision (accepted by the user):** Edge/Notepad3 behavior is the deliverable and is done;
the Feishu behavior is an app-specific limitation of synthesized input — recorded in
CLAUDE.md with workarounds, no further fix attempts. Physical click+Shift+click works in
Feishu (user-verified), so the gap is specific to synthesized input there.

**Status: DONE and CLOSED 2026-08-14.** Report:
[`20260813-225345_triple-click-and-text-select.report.qmd`](20260813-225345_triple-click-and-text-select.report.qmd).

## What was actually built

The original plan (below in this file's history) covered the two features only. The shipped
work additionally includes four fix rounds, each driven by an on-box observation → drop →
user test cycle:

| Round | Change | Commit | Trigger (user observation) | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Features: `ClickAction.Triple` + `<leader>t`; `SelectText` 2-pick + `<leader>v`; `TextSelectMethod` (ShiftClick/Drag) | `3fa79c9`, `9f750df` (+`b5eab8e` shipped-defaults fix) | feature request | Edge/Notepad OK; Feishu `v` failed; later flakiness found |
| 2 | Selection actions close the overlay even in Continuous mode | `6a36a0d` | selection vanished immediately in Continuous | fixed that symptom (one-shot/continuous then differed only by close timing) |
| 3 | Diagnostic toggles `SelectionActionsClose`, `TopmostReassertEnabled` | `24854bf` | test the 100ms topmost re-assert timer hypothesis | hypothesis **disproven** (disabling the timer changed nothing) |
| 4 | Multi-event bursts off-thread with ~20ms real gaps (`FireInputAsync`) | `137069c` (+`c2c7490` XML-comment fix) | "d/v/t succeed randomly at low frequency" (all versions) | **confirmed**: d/t became reliable in Edge/Notepad3 |
| 5 | Pick-1 of `v` always plain-clicks (clear prior selection) for both methods | `8f47655` | Drag-mode `v` alternated work/fail | fixed Drag `v` in Edge; Feishu unchanged |
| 6 | Findings recorded in CLAUDE.md; wrong "use Drag in Feishu" advice removed | `7bcb37e` | final matrix | docs |

## Engineering facts established (by intervention, on-box)

1. **UI-thread input batching**: multi-event bursts (double/triple click, Shift+click, drag)
   run synchronously on the UI thread — the thread that owns the LL hooks — get held by the
   OS and flushed as one 0ms batch; apps mishandle that (observed as random low-frequency
   success). Running the burst on a background thread with real ~20ms gaps fixed d/t
   reliability in Edge/Notepad3. (Single clicks were never affected.) Also documented in
   CLAUDE.md "Performance".
2. **`TextSelectMethod` gates only `v`**: d/t never consult it, so d/t results are identical
   across both modes by construction.
3. **Topmost re-assert timer**: not the cause of the Continuous-mode deselect (disabling it
   on-box changed nothing).

## Outcome / reopen triggers

Accepted limitation for Feishu. Workaround recorded in CLAUDE.md: `<leader>t` every other
attempt (or plain-click empty background first to clear the selection), physical mouse for
arbitrary spans. Reopen if an on-box probe (e.g. an AutoHotkey `Send {Shift down}` +
`Click` + `Send {Shift up}` hotkey) ever shows Feishu accepts some other synthesized form.

## Inference

Items below are interpretation, kept distinct from the verified facts above.

- **"Feishu d/t alternates because the next mousedown lands on the previous selection,
  starting a text drag-drop instead of a click."**
  Reasoning: the alternation is state-dependent (work → fail → work), the same signature
  that pick-1-always-clicks fixed for Drag-`v` in Edge; not directly observed in Feishu.
  To establish this, check: in Feishu, plain-click empty background between attempts —
  if `t` then succeeds every time, the hypothesis holds.
- **"Feishu's chat pane handles text selection differently from Edge's Chromium default."**
  Reasoning: both are Chromium-lineage yet accept/reject the same synthesized input
  differently; no Feishu internals were inspected.
  To establish this, check: Feishu desktop client selection implementation (not available
  off-box).
